name: leif-taylor-resume
description: Living résumé site, PDF, and DOCX for Leif Taylor — generated from a single TypeScript source. Deployed to Cloudflare Pages.
author: Leif Taylor <leif@alacrity.ai> (https://www.linkedin.com/in/leiftaylor/)

scripts.build: tsc -b && tsx scripts/build-og-image.ts && vite build && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.app.json node --import tsx --import ./scripts/prerender-register.mjs prerender.ts && tsx scripts/build-sitemap.ts && tsx scripts/build-robots.ts
scripts.build:fast: tsx scripts/build-og-image.ts && vite build && TSX_TSCONFIG_PATH=tsconfig.app.json node --import tsx --import ./scripts/prerender-register.mjs prerender.ts && tsx scripts/build-sitemap.ts && tsx scripts/build-robots.ts
scripts.resume-pdf: RESUME_SLUG=base npm run build && RESUME_SLUG=base tsx scripts/generate-pdf.ts
scripts.resume-pdf:fast: RESUME_SLUG=base npm run build:fast && RESUME_SLUG=base tsx scripts/generate-pdf.ts
scripts.resumes: npm run resume-pdf && npm run resume-docx
scripts.resumes-all: npm run resume-pdf-all && npm run resume-docx-all
